verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own Entity API docs list a separate non-production endpoint, api-alpha.sam.gov, alongside the production API. That suggests a test or alpha environment, but the evidence shows only the URL. Nothing describes it as a sandbox, explains what data it holds, or covers how to get alpha credentials. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test environment and its isolation from production data, guidance on sandbox API keys or accounts, test/synthetic data description, independent or hands-on corroboration that the alpha endpoint works for testing.
